It is located in the village of Pühajärve in Otepää Parish, Valga County. The Väike Emajõgi River flows out of the lake.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 293.0 hectares (724 acres), and it has four islands with a combined area of 7.1 hectares (18 acres). The lake has an average depth of 4.8 meters (16 ft) and a maximum depth of 8.7 meters (29 ft). It is 3,610 meters (11,840 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 16,280 meters (53,410 ft). It has a volume of 13,982,000 cubic meters (493,800,000 cu ft).
